reviewer_role: separate assistant source reviewer; not the reference author or retrieval builder

review_scope.method: Entire packs inspected against frozen reference claims. Text/row bodies were viewed in full; typed cards were displayed with reversible namespace/entity dictionaries and explicit concept, period, units, dimensions, variants, precision status and occurrence counts. Repeated source headers were shown once for inspection only; all original words remain charged. Equivalent typed or row witnesses were accepted. The display did not change any retrieval pack.
review_scope.question_sufficiency: Question-level claim necessity was adjudicated transparently after retrieval without modifying frozen reference claims. Every claim in this assigned subset answers an explicit part of its question, so all nine distinct claims are required_for_question and strict/question judgments coincide.
review_scope.negative_verdict_scope: Missing means absent from this reviewed supplied pack, not absent from the full filing or the world. Sufficient describes evidence availability, not demonstrated reader competence or external coverage.

interpretation: Structural and decomposition provide sufficient evidence for all three questions in this subset; no residual against those conventional baselines is observed here.

Both SBC questions are supplied completely by lexical, structural and decomposition packs; typed misses are ordinary evidence-representation/query-retrieval limitations and do not establish a novel certificate advantage.
The NFLX lexical FCF pack has a genuine adjustment-premise gap plus a separate FCF-row binding ambiguity; the richer conventional packs already resolve both.
This is small, model-assisted development adjudication on two issuer histories, not held-out QA, a reader gate pass, or an external coverage decision.

prior_source_review_count_clarification.note: The 133 count combines 74 claim-witness anchor occurrences with 59 reviewed-passage inventory locators. It is not a count of 133 claim witnesses; the union contains 59 unique source spans.
